   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 10, 2026 - Jul 24, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Ani Gopinathan Pillai_, Jul 15, 2026, 3/5: "I used to adore this app... until it got frustrating. Now it just crashes every time I open it ... I posted this review at least 3 times in 3 years and still the app just keeps on crashing on me when I need it most..."
            2. _Technopreet Singh_, Jul 5, 2026, 4/5: "I'm big fan of Zoho products including your Notebook app. I used this app daily, only noticed a few bugs, the major one is Notes (including collection) won't delete when I delete them. They immediately comes when I open an Notebook. This problem is a little but annoying bcuz non-essential notes keep mixing up with essential ones. Hope you will take it into consideration."
            3. _Shadman Hussain_, Jul 24, 2026, 5/5: "I am using the Zoho Notebook app for storing UPSC notes. It is a very flexible one and highly suitable for making notes. But recently, certain notes are experiencing lag and "app not responding" message is being shown frequently. I request the Zoho team to resolve the issue and make the experience seamless once again. It would be better if the team makes it robust to handle long notes."
